_comment: Optional per-deployment branding, shared by the HOAST player landing page and the telemetry dashboard (:8090). Mount your filled copy at /brand.json (see docker-compose.override.yml.example). Every key is optional; when the file is absent both pages stay generic. Player text values are HTML. vodDownloads OVERRIDES the built-in default download links (derived from the release pinned in services/loop-source/fetch-demo-content.sh); omit it to keep those.
lead: Describe this deployment: what the source is, and whether it is genuinely live or a replayed recording.

_comment_telemetry: host and boxLinks brand the telemetry dashboard's launcher buttons. host is this deployment's reachable address (a Tailscale name or an IP); omit it and the buttons fall back to whatever address the dashboard was opened on. boxLinks overrides the built-in button list (label + port + path, all resolved on host); omit it to keep the defaults shown below. Do not use TEL_HOST for this: it is only a display label.
_comment_guestDisclaimer: Shown under the player ONLY while a guest session holds the endpoint (GUEST_ENABLED deployments). short = one line by the badge, full = the complete notice; en + pl because GDPR notices are expected in the server's local language. affiliationNotice is a reserved slot for an institutional line; optional institutional line; leave empty to omit it.

en.short: Open test endpoint: this stream was submitted by a third party.
en.full:
Open test endpoint. Anyone may broadcast to this endpoint. Streams are submitted by third parties and are not reviewed before they appear. Sessions end automatically after {MAX_H} hours.

To report a stream, use the report button below. Reported streams are reviewed and removed where appropriate.

Connection details, including IP address, are logged for the purpose of operating and moderating the service, and are retained for {RETENTION_DAYS} days. Anonymised session statistics (country, truncated network address, duration, end reason) are kept beyond that period.

If you report a stream, your IP address is logged with the report to prevent abuse of the reporting function, and is retained under the same {RETENTION_DAYS}-day rule.

Publishers who misuse the endpoint may be blocked by network address for up to {BAN_DAYS} days.

pl.short: Otwarty punkt testowy: ta transmisja pochodzi od osoby trzeciej.
pl.full:
Otwarty punkt testowy. Każdy może nadawać na ten punkt. Transmisje są przesyłane przez osoby trzecie i nie są sprawdzane przed ich pojawieniem się. Sesje kończą się automatycznie po maksymalnie {MAX_H} godz.

Aby zgłosić transmisję, użyj przycisku poniżej. Zgłoszone transmisje są sprawdzane i w uzasadnionych przypadkach usuwane.

Szczegóły połączenia, w tym adres IP, są rejestrowane w celu obsługi i moderacji usługi oraz przechowywane przez {RETENTION_DAYS} dni. Zanonimizowane statystyki sesji (kraj, skrócony adres sieciowy, czas trwania, powód zakończenia) są przechowywane dłużej.

W przypadku zgłoszenia transmisji adres IP zgłaszającego jest rejestrowany wraz ze zgłoszeniem w celu zapobiegania nadużyciom funkcji zgłaszania i przechowywany zgodnie z tą samą zasadą {RETENTION_DAYS} dni.

Nadawcy nadużywający punktu końcowego mogą zostać zablokowani na podstawie adresu sieciowego na okres do {BAN_DAYS} dni.

_comment_guestDisclaimer_tokens: {MAX_H}, {RETENTION_DAYS} and {BAN_DAYS} interpolate at render time from the running config (via /api/live), so the numeric claims cannot drift from what the arbiter actually enforces. Keep the tokens when editing the wording.
_comment_vodBase: Empty or absent = VOD served from this host. Set to a URL to serve it externally. The URL is prepended to the /vod-dash/... paths, so the remote must mirror that tree and allow CORS from the player origin, including the 'range' request header (DASH SegmentBase addresses by byte range).
_comment_webAnalyticsToken: Optional Cloudflare Web Analytics site token; when set, the VOD page (and only the VOD page) loads the cookieless beacon. The token is public by nature (it appears in page source) but deployment-specific, hence here and not in the committed page. Create the Web Analytics site with automatic setup DISABLED, or Cloudflare injects the beacon on every proxied page including the live player.
